body:
This is really awesome @JanPetr I think this can be a big deal, especially in Magento/Shopify/WooCommerce.

> Yeah, I was just thinking that those analytics code are always backward compatible and don't change that often; but it's probably fine uncommenting those lines (or recopying those lines) in every single project.

I tend to agree with that statement, I would love to have a widget for GA that comes with some sensible defaults.

I would really militate in favor of detecting the global variables that are there and just push the data. That's is the Algolia spirit!

Then if you override some params, you can customize the default behaviour.

WDYT?
